title: AI Contribution Policy Configuration Schema
description: Standard machine-readable JSON Schema for defining AI-assisted and AI-generated contribution policies in software projects (ai-policy.yml).

version.description: Schema specification version. For v0.1, must be '0.1' or '0.1.x'.

level.description: Overall repository policy posture towards AI-generated or AI-assisted contributions.

policy_url.description: Canonical URL pointing to the human-readable policy documentation.

policy_path.description: Repository-relative file path to the human-readable policy document (e.g. 'docs/ai-policy.md').

code.description: Rules for source code generated or assisted by AI models.

docs.description: Rules for documentation, spell-checking, translations, and comments.

tests.description: Rules for automated test cases and test suites.

reviews.description: Rules for peer review feedback generated by AI tools.

issues.description: Rules for issue descriptions, bug reports, or automated issue filing.

disclosure.description: Requirements for disclosing the use of generative AI tools in contributions.

required.description: Whether contributors are mandated to explicitly disclose AI tool usage.
Whether this commit trailer must be present on commits containing AI contributions.

pattern.description: Regular expression pattern the trailer value must satisfy.

tool_name_required.description: Whether the specific tool or model name (e.g. Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT) must be stated.

prompt_disclosure.description: Expectation for publishing prompts used during artifact generation.

accountability.description: Requirements regarding human contributor comprehension and legal/technical responsibility.

author_understands_code.description: Whether the contributor must attest to fully understanding all submitted code.

author_takes_responsibility.description: Whether the contributor assumes full technical and legal liability for the contribution.

dco_signoff.description: Whether a Developer Certificate of Origin (Signed-off-by trailer) is required.

bots.description: Governance policies for automated bots, autonomous PRs, and AI scrapers.

automated_prs.description: Policy on autonomous or bot-initiated pull requests without maintainer sponsorship.

automated_reviews.description: Policy on unsolicited automated AI review comments on pull requests.

automated_issues.description: Policy on automated AI-filed bug reports and issues.

bot_allowlist.description: Authorized bot usernames exempt from automated bot restrictions (e.g. dependabot[bot]).
